Name: Alternative Bundles
Author: Quirinea
Description:
This is just a small redoing of bundles. Most Community Center bundles have different items, but keeping the original ideas and names. Also the difficulty should be at the same level (but there are e.g. fish of night market and the new ones of version 1.4.)

Just so it's not again and again those parsnips and potatoes.

Some crop bundles have crops not available  on the first year, though. Unless you have [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/3012]Better mixed seeds[/url]﻿.

Foraging group has only small changes, crops, fish and bulletin board are more extensively worked.

Requires SMAPI and content patcher.
Then just drop the mod into your mod folder.
Obviously incompatible with other mods for bundles but shouldn't mess up anything else.

Downloads.Description: A little different set of bundles
